placement.preparation: all four CPUs shared until 180-second release
placement.S: driver all four CPUs/GOMAXPROCS 4; nodes same four/GOMAXPROCS 2
placement.O: driver one CPU/GOMAXPROCS 1; nodes fixed three CPUs/GOMAXPROCS 2 including driver CPU
placement.D: driver sibling CPU/GOMAXPROCS 1; nodes same three CPUs/GOMAXPROCS 2 excluding driver CPU

analysis.primary_screen: Both pairs, per endpoint: D median of three driver-wait P99 values decreases >=25% and >=1ms, with total P99 in the same direction; a screen, not a causal verdict.
analysis.repeats: Report S/S, O/O, D/D variation and every window; do not pool P99 or select favorable windows.
analysis.limitations: Numeric rejects remain. Latency includes attempted requests (including errors), but excludes dropped arrivals. Equal per-role widths do not equalize total eligible CPUs (union 3 vs 4); SMT, cache, visible cgroup and hidden host contention remain. S/D is not a single-variable contrast.
analysis.verdict: Collection completion is not performance acceptance or historical root-cause confirmation.
